mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from OpenAI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest OpenAI release in this tracker is GPT-6.1 Sol, released Sep 29, 2026. An upgraded GPT-6 Sol that OpenAI says comes close to its flagship GPT-6 Astra on coding, computer use and professional workflows at a fraction of the cost. Available in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, but not yet in the main ChatGPT chat.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Anthropic?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Anthropic release in this tracker is Claude Sonnet 5.5, released Sep 28, 2026. Anthropic's new mid-tier model in the 5.5 family, aimed at everyday work like coding fixes, documents, slides and spreadsheets. It runs noticeably faster and cheaper per task than Sonnet 5, and Anthropic says Haiku 5.5 will follow in the coming weeks.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from Meta?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest Meta release in this tracker is Muse Spark 1.3, released Sep 2, 2026. Meta Superintelligence Labs' updated frontier model for coding and long-running agent work, now in Muse Code and Meta's API. The notable change is behavioral: it asks clarifying questions when a prompt is ambiguous, pulls the user in when it gets stuck, and checks before taking consequential actions — while using fewer tool calls and tokens than 1.2.

mainEntity.name: What is the latest AI model from DeepSeek?

acceptedAnswer.text: The latest DeepSeek release in this tracker is DeepSeek V4-Pro (0813 Official Release), released Aug 12, 2026. DeepSeek's flagship V4-Pro model graduated from preview to full production after a nearly four-month preview period, with no changes to API pricing or integration for existing users.

Evertune's agents do the work for you: a prompt agent mines over 150 million real user conversations to find the exact questions buyers ask, an insights agent tells you what to do next each week, and an ads agent builds a complete ChatGPT campaign around your visibility gaps. From there, Evertune closes the loop with website optimization, data-driven content creation, source-level influence mapping and paid activation through affiliate and programmatic AI retargeting partners. Founded by the team that pioneered programmatic advertising at The Trade Desk, now building the next marketing channel.
